segments.t: En el soleado rincón de la cafetería, Arthur se planta erguido frente a Tessa y Hannah con la segunda página de la carta aún en la mano y una sonrisa enorme. Escuchemos primero.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
Best first week of my life!
Repasemos línea por línea estas grandes noticias.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
'Tessa, ¿cuántos rollos de canela y pasteles de limón puede hornear tu horno cada mañana?'
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
'¡El doble de lo que hago ahora! ¿De verdad vamos a abrir la cafetería del patio a nuestra calle?'
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
'¡Empezando mañana a las ocho! ¡Cuatro mesas dentro, tres mesas bajo el árbol!'
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
'¡La cafetería de mis sueños, justo aquí en nuestro propio patio! ¡Esperen a que se lo cuente a toda la calle!'
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
'Y ahora, Hannah, hoy es viernes, el último día de tu semana de prueba de cinco días.'
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
'¡Oh! ¡Con las maletas, la caldera y la carta, se me olvidó por completo!'
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
'El lunes abriste nuestra puerta con truco; desde entonces salvaste habitaciones, tuberías, el desayuno y nuestro contrato.'
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
'¡Si no la contratas a jornada completa, Arthur, la contrato yo en mi cocina!'
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
'¡Quieta ahí, Tessa! Hannah, ¿te quedarías como nuestra encargada fija de recepción?'
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
'¿Quedarme aquí con todos ustedes? ¡Sí, cien veces sí!'
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
'¡Maravilloso! ¡Tu nombre entra en el gran libro de papel de Graham con tinta permanente!'
Best first week of my life!
'¡La mejor primera semana de mi vida!'
Volvamos a oír la escena completa de corrido.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
Best first week of my life!
¡Una cafetería abierta al barrio para Tessa y un puesto fijo de encargada de recepción para Hannah! En la próxima escena cae la tarde y se encienden los farolillos del patio.
See you later!
